resources.string: Remaps the SystemUI battery percentage with a configurable full-charge level.
Physical 5% always displays as 5%. The range from 5% to the selected full level is stretched up to displayed 100%.
Modern Xposed service unavailable. Enable the module and use a framework with API 101 or newer.
The connected Xposed framework does not provide remote preferences, so the full-level setting cannot be changed from the app.
